queries.sql:
WITH current_actuals AS (
        SELECT a.plan_account_code AS account_code, SUM(a.mapped_amount) AS amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_MAPPED_ACTUALS a
        WHERE a.period = '2026-09'
          
          
        GROUP BY a.plan_account_code
      ),
      compare_actuals AS (
        SELECT a.plan_account_code AS account_code, SUM(a.mapped_amount) AS amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_MAPPED_ACTUALS a
        WHERE a.period = '2026-08'
          
          
        GROUP BY a.plan_account_code
      ),
      plan_current AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(m.plan_account_code, p.account_code) AS account_code, SUM(p.amount) AS amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
        LEFT JOIN SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.MAP_GL_TO_PLAN m ON p.account_code = m.gl_account_code
        WHERE p.version_id = 2 AND p.period = '2026-09'
          
          
        GROUP BY COALESCE(m.plan_account_code, p.account_code)
      )
      SELECT
        d.account_code,
        d.account_name,
        d.statement_section,
        d.sort_order,
        d.sign_convention,
        COALESCE(c.amount, 0) AS current_actual,
        COALESCE(cmp.amount, 0) AS compare_actual,
        COALESCE(pl.amount, 0) AS plan_amount
      FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT d
      LEFT JOIN current_actuals c ON c.account_code = d.account_code
      LEFT JOIN compare_actuals cmp ON cmp.account_code = d.account_code
      LEFT JOIN plan_current pl ON pl.account_code = d.account_code
      WHERE d.statement_section IN ('Revenue', 'COGS')
        AND d.is_leaf = TRUE
      ORDER BY d.sort_order
